head.title: Marquez Custom Cabinets · Kitchen Cabinets and Countertops in Tampa, FL
head.description: Marquez Custom Cabinets, Tampa FL: custom kitchen cabinets, countertop installation and full kitchen remodels. 5.0 stars, 63 Google reviews. Call +1 (813) 352-8027.
head.og_description: Custom kitchen cabinets and countertop installation. 5.0 stars on Google.

parrafo.es: Yuri y su equipo diseñan e instalan gabinetes de cocina, cubiertas y remodelaciones completas en Tampa. Cada proyecto se hace a la medida exacta del espacio.
parrafo.en: Yuri and his team design and install kitchen cabinets, countertops and full remodels across Tampa. Every project is built to the exact size of the space.

hero.imagen_alt: Cocina remodelada con gabinetes grises y cubiertas de cuarzo, Marquez Custom Cabinets

parrafo_1.es: Marquez Custom Cabinets diseña e instala gabinetes de cocina, islas y cubiertas de cuarzo o granito en Tampa. Yuri y su hermano trabajan cada proyecto de principio a fin, desde el diseño hasta la instalacion final.
parrafo_1.en: Marquez Custom Cabinets designs and installs kitchen cabinets, islands and quartz or granite countertops across Tampa. Yuri and his brother handle every project start to finish, from the design to the final install.

parrafo_2.es: 63 reseñas en Google con 5.0 de calificacion, muchas de clientes que han vuelto a contratarlos para una segunda o tercera cocina.
parrafo_2.en: 63 Google reviews at a 5.0 rating, many from clients who came back for a second or third kitchen.

texto.es: Yuri visita tu cocina, toma medidas exactas y escucha que buscas.
texto.en: Yuri visits your kitchen, takes exact measurements and listens to what you want.

texto.es: Te proponemos el diseño de gabinetes y cubiertas con el precio detallado.
texto.en: We propose a cabinet and countertop design with a detailed price.

nota.es: Cada cocina se cotiza segun diseño y materiales. Llama y te damos el detalle.

items.quote: I could not be more pleased with the phenomenal work Marquez custom cabinets did with transforming my kitchen by adding new quartz Countertops. 1st, the price was extremely competitive and they helped me find the perfect quartz for my ...

I have had Marquez Cabinets do multiple jobs for us, and will always be doing business with him. We had our first kitchen done with him and his team, they did a great job with handle placement and counter top installation.
Absolutely thrilled with the incredible work Yuri and his brother have done for us! This is the second time we've enlisted their services, and each experience has exceeded our expectations.
